description: NSAllowsArbitraryLoads turns App Transport Security off for the whole app. App Review asks for a justification, and an app that sends user data over an unencrypted connection is rejected.

remediation.summary: Remove NSAllowsArbitraryLoads and add an NSExceptionDomains entry for each domain that still needs an exception.

title: App Transport Security is disabled for every domain

description: An app distributed on the Mac App Store must declare the App Sandbox entitlement so it runs with restricted file system and system access.

interpretations.interpretation: Any macOS target submitted to the Mac App Store must carry com.apple.security.app-sandbox set to true in its entitlements file.

remediation.summary: Add the App Sandbox entitlement to the macOS target and request only the specific sandbox capabilities the app needs.

title: Mac App Store apps must enable App Sandbox

Remove the blanket kids_category exclusion; instead only exempt apps that declare an educational-coding purpose AND expose/allow editing of the downloaded source code (e.g., a fact like 'educational_code_teaching_purpose' combined with a check for source viewability), rather than exempting the entire kids category.

description: Flags use of APIs that load or execute code at runtime, such as dlopen/dlsym, NSTask/posix_spawn, JSContext.evaluateScript, and Objective-C runtime class creation. These are the usual mechanisms for running code that was not compiled into the bundle and need review against the self-contained-bundle requirement. This check reads the use of a dynamic execution API. It cannot tell whether the code being run came from the bundle or from the network, and the guideline turns on exactly that.

examples: Link the framework statically or as an embedded framework instead of calling dlopen on a downloaded binary.
Only pass evaluateJavaScript strings that are literals or bundled resources, never text fetched from a server.
remediation.summary: Remove runtime code-loading APIs, or confirm the executed code ships inside the bundle and does not come from the network.

title: Dynamic code loading and interpreter APIs detected
